intro: Some of this is quiet practice. Some of it is standing in front of people.

items.title: On Stage at Ponnonam 2026
items.description: On 22 August 2026, I performed violin at Ponnonam 2026, a community cultural event — playing alongside another musician on percussion, in front of a live audience.

images.alt: Rithu playing violin on stage next to another musician playing hand percussion, in front of a "Ponnonam 2026" banner

items.title: Performing With Various Bands
items.description: I've also performed with a number of different bands — details to come.

images.alt: Rithu playing violin on stage alongside a band of other student musicians on saxophone, flute, and clarinet

items.title: All Around the World: Music Trivia
items.description: During Multicultural Week, I hosted an International Music Trivia Challenge in the library at lunch — playing a mix of songs from around the world and challenging people to name the title, the language, and the country each one came from. It turned into a proper competition, with plenty of deliberation over every clue.

images.alt: Rithu holding a microphone and speaking in front of a projected "All Around the World Music Trivia" title slide
Rithu gesturing toward the room while hosting the music trivia challenge

items.title: Playing at Church
items.description: Since May 2024, I've been playing violin with my church's music ministry — a regular, ongoing way to use music for something bigger than just practising at home.
